title: BEST 1.21 RAID FARM Minecraft Tutorial - EASY & INFINITE!
description: In this tutorial, I will show you how to build the next generation of instant raid farming. Not only can it instantly kill mobs, but it also finishes the raids extremely quickly compared to any raid farm you've seen before. It's easy, cheap, and simple to build. Also, it can be used even with a wooden sword without encountering vexes in Minecraft!
